# Rebuild brief: Placar Aberto

You are rebuilding every page of the **Placar Aberto** template, a news site (angle: guides-first). Keep the section order, the content and every rule below. Write the page text exactly as given (it is in Portuguese); write code and comments in English.

**Target stack:** WordPress with the SX ACF blocks (`sx/<block>` from `wp/sx-blocks.php`). If you use another stack (plain HTML/CSS, React/Next.js, another CMS), build one component per section below with the listed fields as props.

## Site context

- Site: Placar Aberto (https://placaraberto.example)
- Market: Brazil (`br`), language `pt`, text direction `ltr`, currency BRL
- Minimum age: 18+
- Products allowed: sports betting yes, online casino yes
- Market note: Regulated under Lei 14.790/2023. Licensed operators use .bet.br domains. Advance bonuses are prohibited; PIX is the default payment rail; credit cards are not accepted.
- Pages (13):
  - `index.html` — Placar Aberto: notícias e guias de apostas no Brasil
  - `guides-como-funciona-o-saque-pix.html` — Saque via PIX em casas de apostas: prazos, limites e o que pode atrasar | Placar Aberto
  - `news-o-que-muda-com-bet-br.html` — Domínio .bet.br: como saber se o site é autorizado | Placar Aberto
  - `guides-limites-de-deposito-guia.html` — Como definir limites de depósito e de tempo na sua conta | Placar Aberto
  - `partner-content-nyxa-app-pix-tempo-real.html` — Nyxa passa a mostrar o status do saque PIX em tempo real no app | Placar Aberto
  - `guides-odds-decimais-explicadas.html` — Odds decimais: como ler e calcular o retorno de uma aposta | Placar Aberto
  - `news-brasileirao-reta-final.html` — Reta final do Brasileirão concentra o maior volume de apostas do ano | Placar Aberto
  - `partner-content-marlowe-mesas-ao-vivo-portugues.html` — Marlowe Club abre novas mesas ao vivo com crupiês em português | Placar Aberto
  - `news-publicidade-de-apostas-novas-regras.html` — Publicidade de apostas: o que as regras proíbem | Placar Aberto
  - `news.html` — Notícias do mercado de apostas | Placar Aberto
  - `guides.html` — Guias de apostas | Placar Aberto
  - `partner-content.html` — Conteúdo de parceiros | Placar Aberto
  - `about.html` — Sobre o Placar Aberto e o conteúdo pago

## Design tokens

Fonts (Google Fonts): Manrope.

Use these CSS custom properties (they are the whole palette, type scale and radius set):

```css
:root {
  --c-bg: #FFFFFF;
  --c-surface: #F5F7FB;
  --c-surface-2: #EBEFF7;
  --c-text: #0E1525;
  --c-muted: #556079;
  --c-border: #E2E7F0;
  --c-accent: #2457FF;
  --c-on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --c-accent-2: #00C2A8;
  --c-success: #1F9D55;
  --c-warning: #D98B00;
  --c-danger: #D93636;
  --c-hero-text: #0E1525;
  --c-hero-muted: #556079;
  --c-hero-accent: #2457FF;
  --c-hero-on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --hero-bg: linear-gradient(180deg,#EEF2FF 0%,#FFFFFF 100%);
  --f-display: "Manrope",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-body: "Manrope",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "Manrope",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --fw-heading: 800;
  --fw-body: 400;
  --fw-strong: 500;
  --tt-heading: none;
  --ls-heading: -0.03em;
  --lh-body: 1.6;
  --lh-heading: 1.15;
  --r-sm: 8px;
  --r: 12px;
  --r-lg: 20px;
  --r-btn: 12px;
  --bw: 1px;
  --density: 1.15;
  --fs-0: 12.8px;
  --fs-1: 16px;
  --fs-2: 25px;
  --fs-3: clamp(21.25px,16.96px + 1.19vw,31.25px);
  --fs-4: clamp(26.56px,21.21px + 1.488vw,39.06px);
  --fs-5: clamp(33.2px,26.51px + 1.86vw,48.83px);
  --fs-6: clamp(41.5px,33.13px + 2.325vw,61.04px);
  --sp-1: 4.6px;
  --sp-2: 9.2px;
  --sp-3: 13.8px;
  --sp-4: 18.4px;
  --sp-5: 27.6px;
  --sp-6: 36.8px;
  --sp-7: 55.2px;
  --sp-8: 73.6px;
  --sp-9: 110.4px;
  --card-bg: #F5F7FB;
  --card-border: transparent;
  --card-shadow: none;
  --surface-style: flat;
}
```

Layout is mobile-first: it must work from 375px to 1440px wide.

## Rules you must not break

- Every page opens with an age gate (18+) before any gambling content.
- Every page has the responsible-gambling panel (usually in the footer) with the market text: age notice, licence line, taglines, self-exclusion and helpline where given. Never type this text yourself; it comes from the market settings.
- Affiliate disclosure: Fixed wording per locale; cannot be removed on review sites.
- Header: One-page landing and app pages use 'minimal' (no nav) so attention stays on the conversion.
- Header: The CTA stays visible at every width; on mobile the nav collapses into a menu, the CTA does not.
- Lead stories: PR articles are never the lead story.
- Article list: Paid (pr) articles always carry the Sponsored label and sponsor name.
- Footer: Always renders the compliance panel; it cannot be switched off.
- Footer: Payment methods come from the market config so they are always locally correct.
- Responsible gambling: All copy comes from markets/<id>.json; never type compliance text into a page.
- Responsible gambling: Every page renders a 'panel' (usually inside the footer). 'strip' is an optional top-of-page addition.
- Responsible gambling: Where a market lists several mandated taglines, one is chosen per site by seed.
- Age gate: Age comes from the market (21 in KZ, 18 in AU/BR). Never hard-code it.
- Age gate: Content stays in the HTML for crawlers; the overlay is shown by script, so no-JS users still see the compliance footer.
- Sticky CTA: Phones only (860px and narrower). Never covers the compliance panel: the footer gets bottom padding.
- Sticky CTA: Shows the market age badge next to the CTA.
- Article body: Paid articles show the Sponsored label, the sponsor and a disclosure box; their brand links are rel="sponsored nofollow".
- Article body: Paid articles get no NewsArticle structured data.
- Page title: The answer line states the page's key fact in one sentence, above the fold on phones.
- Text block: Only h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, strong, em, a, table, blockquote survive; all attributes except href are removed.
- Text block: Links: page:<id> for internal pages, https:// for sources. Brand links belong in CTAs, not in prose.
- Page links: Internal links only; never a substitute for the brand CTA.

## Page `index.html`

- Title tag: Placar Aberto: notícias e guias de apostas no Brasil
- Meta description: Guias práticos sobre saque PIX, odds e limites, notícias do mercado regulado e conteúdo de parceiros sempre identificado. 18+.
- The only H1: Notícias e guias de apostas no Brasil
- Structured data (JSON-LD): WebPage, WebSite
- Links to: `about.html`, `news.html`, `guides.html`, `partner-content.html`, `index.html`, `guides-como-funciona-o-saque-pix.html`, `news-o-que-muda-com-bet-br.html`, `guides-limites-de-deposito-guia.html`, `guides-odds-decimais-explicadas.html`, `news-brasileirao-reta-final.html`, `news-publicidade-de-apostas-novas-regras.html`, `partner-content-nyxa-app-pix-tempo-real.html`, `partner-content-marlowe-mesas-ao-vivo-portugues.html`

### Sections, in order

1. **Affiliate disclosure** — block `sx/disclosure`, variant `line`, role `top`
   Purpose: One-line affiliate disclosure with a link to the moderation policy. Every page of a review site.
2. **Header** — block `sx/header`, variant `centered`, role `header`
   Purpose: Site header with logo, navigation and primary CTA.
   - `sticky`: false
   - `show_cta`: false
3. **Lead stories** — block `sx/article-lead`, variant `stack`, role `content`
   Purpose: Home masthead: H1 and the newest news or guide stories (split, stack or numbered wire). Never paid content.
   - `title`: "Notícias e guias de apostas no Brasil"
4. **Article list** — block `sx/article-list`, variant `cards`, role `content`
   Purpose: Articles newest first: one kind or all, with the Sponsored label on paid ones, optional paging and a "see all" link.
   - `heading`: "h2"
   - `title`: "Guias para começar"
   - `kind`: "guide"
   - `exclude_pr`: false
   - `skip_lead`: true
   - `limit`: "3"
   - `more`: "guides"
   - `exclude_current`: false
5. **Article list** — block `sx/article-list`, variant `list`, role `content`
   Purpose: Articles newest first: one kind or all, with the Sponsored label on paid ones, optional paging and a "see all" link.
   - `heading`: "h2"
   - `title`: "Últimas notícias"
   - `exclude_pr`: true
   - `skip_lead`: true
   - `limit`: "6"
   - `more`: "news"
   - `exclude_current`: false
6. **Article list** — block `sx/article-list`, variant `rail`, role `content`
   Purpose: Articles newest first: one kind or all, with the Sponsored label on paid ones, optional paging and a "see all" link.
   - `heading`: "h2"
   - `title`: "Conteúdo de parceiros"
   - `kind`: "pr"
   - `exclude_pr`: false
   - `skip_lead`: false
   - `limit`: "3"
   - `more`: "partners"
   - `exclude_current`: false
7. **Footer** — block `sx/footer`, variant `compact`, role `footer`
   Purpose: Footer with links, payment methods, the compliance panel and copyright.
   - `show_verify`: false
  - inside it: **Responsible gambling** — block `sx/compliance-bar`, variant `panel`
     - `show_verify`: false
8. **Age gate** — block `sx/age-gate`, variant `fullscreen`, role `age-gate`
   Purpose: Age confirmation overlay using the market's minimum age. Remembers the answer for 30 days.
   - `leave_url`: "https://www.google.com"
   - `preview`: false
9. **Sticky CTA** — block `sx/sticky-cta`, variant `pill`, role `sticky`
   Purpose: Bottom CTA on phones. Appears once the hero CTA scrolls away; hides while the final CTA is on screen.

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Sections appear in the order above, with the same layout variant (or an equivalent layout).
- [ ] All text is used exactly as given; nothing invented (no extra claims, figures, offers or reviews).
- [ ] One H1 per page; headings do not skip levels.
- [ ] No horizontal scrolling at 375px; tap targets at least 44px.
- [ ] Each page is under 64 KB of HTML and CSS (images excluded).
- [ ] The structured data listed for each page is present and valid.
- [ ] Every internal link opens an existing page.
- [ ] Text contrast meets WCAG AA, focus is visible, images have alt text.
- [ ] Every rule in "Rules you must not break" holds on every page.

_Long text and lists are shortened here (…, "[n items]"). For the full text run `php build/ai-brief.php sites/demos/<config>.json`._
